article.story: BOZEMAN, Mont. -- — Christian King’s 18 points helped Montana State defeat Cal Poly 77-52 on Sunday. King shot 7 for 13, including 4 for 8 from beyond the arc for the Bobcats (2-2). Jaden Steppe scored 15 points and added five rebounds. Cavin Holden had 15 points and went 5 of 9 from the field (3 for 6 from 3-point range). Hamad Mousa led the Mustangs (2-3) in scoring, finishing with 19 points and three steals. Jess Esso Essis added 11 points and eight rebounds for Cal Poly. Cayden Ward finished with seven points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
